metadata.title: Trimble Inc. stock underperforms Wednesday when compared to competitors - MarketWatch

content.text:
Company Close Updates
Trimble Inc. stock underperforms Wednesday when compared to competitors
Shares of Trimble Inc. TRMB plunged 17.31% to $54.25 Wednesday, on what proved to be an all-around favorable trading session for the stock market, with the S&P 500 Index SPX rising 1.58% to 7,688.62 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA rising 3.03% to 53,356.12.
This was the stock's second consecutive day of losses.
